{{Top|leg}}
'''Judgment Field''' was a location in [[Montellian Serat/Legends|Montellian Serat]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] used for executions by [[quarra]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> It was the site of [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc's]] execution-he had been the leader of the military unit that shelled Montellian Serat to rubble after massacring around 700 prisoners there.<ref name="The Last One Standing">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
